operation.body:
## Goal
Implement the approved R-001 no-overlap/no-catch-up sampling rules as a pure DiscoveryCore state machine driven by supplied monotonic elapsed times, with synthetic clock tests. This is a scheduling-policy increment before any live runtime.

## Acceptance criteria
- Use existing validated CollectionConfiguration bounds. Model scheduled slots, bounded missed-slot gaps, one in-flight frame, explicit completion and absorbing cancellation/normal finish; at most 600 slots.
- Schedule from the session origin with the first slot at one interval. A late poll skips expired slots and reports them, never emits catch-up bursts, and permits at most one frame within the current slot and session duration. Preserve the final exact-duration slot; close once its remaining opportunity has expired.
- Repeated polls while a frame is in flight cannot start another. Caller completion releases only that frame. Cancellation stops future starts; no timer, source execution, cancellation guarantee, or worker lifecycle is implied.
- Use finite nondecreasing elapsed seconds supplied by a future monotonic clock. Invalid or backwards internal clock values fail closed with a typed terminal reason; no parsing or external input surface. Tests cover exact/fractional boundaries, large jumps, busy frames, cancellation, terminal states, zero/600 slots and independent instances.
- Document the timing convention and integration limitations in development/specification documentation; retain CLI live refusal. Run existing synthetic product/adapter checks, integrated review, signed PR handoff and CI. Assess actual risk/auto-merge eligibility under project policy.

## Constraints
Parent Project #1, current local self-correcting-review auto-merge authorization; one goal only. Eligible Low-risk changes only may agent-squash; mandatory human-review/safety gates remain. This implements accepted R-001 collection timing without adopting native calls or changing security/privacy boundaries. Preserve private workflow, historical reference and unrelated .gitlab/. Risks: slot rounding, catch-up bursts, accidentally overlapping frames, cancellation confused with stopping kernel work. Decision queue: no blocking material choices; live runtime timing/deadlines, process isolation and report integration remain separate. New pure API is internal scheduling policy, not a source or CLI boundary.

## Out of scope
Live collection, hardware commands/tests, native/SMC calls, privilege, workloads, timers/sleep, workers/IPC/deadline enforcement, persistence, report/CLI integration, payload validation, dependencies/toolchains/CI changes, control/GUI/recovery, background automation and a second goal.

## Relevant context
Approved R-001 in docs/discovery-specification.md lines on collection bounds, no overlapping/catch-up frames and cancellation; docs/development.md; Sources/DiscoveryCore/CollectionConfiguration (in DemoReport.swift); .ai/project/; .ai/docs/project-requirements.md. All delegated goals 2,7,9,11,13,15 are terminal in merged PRs 3,8,10,12,14,16. Authoritative main 795521233de101189d9708658ada97511194adda has green CI run 43643035299. No outstanding deferred owner validation. Source failure policy remains independent; no hardware approval granted.

Rollback: reviewed forward revert PR; pure in-memory state, no deployed service or stored reports.
